verdict.rationale: Flagsmith explicitly documents that 'Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API' (flagsmith-docs-30/40), covering project/environment/flag/segment/user management, and this is further reinforced by an official CLI and MCP server that wrap the same Admin API for AI agents. Missing for 10: no independently discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt was found by probes, and no third-party/hands-on confirmation that the API-UI parity claim holds in practice.
